brief.claim: Across the advanced economies in the post-war period, average real GDP growth in country-years with a public debt ratio above 90 percent of GDP is at least 2 percentage points lower than average real GDP growth in country-years with a debt ratio of 90 percent or below.

data_keys.meaning: real GDP growth rate in percent of each country in each year
public debt as a percentage of GDP of each country in each year
